## Install

- **macOS** (13 or later, Apple silicon): download `Trek-0.2.0-beta.2-darwin-aarch64.dmg`, open it and drag **Trek** onto **Applications**. Apple hasn't notarized Trek, so macOS won't open it the first time: click **Done**, then in **System Settings › Privacy & Security** scroll to **Security**, click **Open Anyway** beside "Trek was blocked" and **Open Anyway** again. It asks only once. (`Trek-0.2.0-beta.2-darwin-aarch64.app.tar.gz` is the same app as an archive: unpack it and move **Trek.app** to Applications.)
- **Windows**: `Trek-0.2.0-beta.2-windows-x86_64.zip`. Unzip it into a folder of its own that Windows doesn't guard, such as `C:\Users\<you>\Trek` or `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Trek` (not Documents, Desktop, Downloads or Program Files), and run `trek.exe`. SmartScreen warns once: **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Updates install in place from Settings → Updates.
